title: Establish captured-packet ground truth
description:
Establish provenance for a bounded public LR-FHSS capture corpus and independent transmitter ground truth. Pin dataset identity/checksums, sample format/rate, center frequency, profile/DR, capture setup and original transmitted bytes. Inspect primary Semtech transmitter/reference material where useful.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Public metadata/documentary work only until lrfhss.09 clears restricted use. Do not transmit new packets, contact authors or download/execute restricted tooling as an implicit workaround. Dataset provenance must precede decoder qualification.
acceptance_criteria: Each active case has independently known payload bytes and sufficient capture metadata. Receiver printouts, self-roundtrips and CRC success are not the payload oracle. Inaccessible datasets or absent transmitter-byte mappings are reported unverified and cannot support a passing reproduction claim.
